title: Data Center Boom Drives US Grid Innovation
excerpt: The artificial intelligence boom is putting pressure on the power grid, creating new opportunities for modernization according to insiders.
body_html:
The rapid growth of the artificial intelligence sector is placing significant stress on the existing power grid. However, according to industry insiders, this pressure is also creating new opportunities for grid modernization.

As data center expansion continues to demand more energy, stakeholders are finding ways to innovate and adapt the US grid infrastructure to meet these emerging challenges.
